title: Sam Altman: OpenAI CEO on GPT-4, ChatGPT, and the Future of AI | Lex Fridman Podcast #367
summary: Lex Fridman's long interview with OpenAI CEO Sam Altman about GPT-4, ChatGPT, and the future of AI. Topics include models as reasoning engines, AI risk, and consciousness.
why: HN mostly cites it for specific Altman quotes, such as models as reasoning engines rather than databases, while many commenters found the interview shallow or insincere.

quote.text: too much of the processing power is going into using the model as a database instead of using the model as a reasoning engine
